cases.head: ec72266fe7e34cd4804972b1499bac17b871e2a2
cases.title: Integrate fixed thread-pool bulkheads with Spring
cases.description: Add thread-pool bulkhead configuration support, including deriving a builder from an existing configuration, and update integrations and tests.

expected.description: A builder derived via from(base) aliases base, so changing the derived configuration mutates the original.
expected.evidence: The change adds from(config) and a Builder constructor assigning the supplied config directly. Builder setters mutate that instance. Later repair cec580d01b3fc33dcb501043463f18ca881b9779 copies fields and adds fromShouldNotMutateBaseConfig and fromShouldCopyAllFields. This is source/upstream-test evidence, not a local Java test result.

cases.notes: One deliberately larger case, above the normal 1500-line cap; needs an explicit max_diff_lines=2000 eval setting. No automatic override. No JDK is installed, so Java tests have not run. Full history was fetched to establish the original introduction rather than a shallow-history boundary.
